title: 上部 凡尘问道 第17章 林浩怨同命相怜上部 凡尘问道 第18章 决赛场反设计陷阱
content_zh:
第1节废灵根截道，破法者遇同途
外门大比决赛前夜，宗门后山的竹林里，一道黑影突然窜出，拦住了凌无妄的去路。
来人身着洗得发白的灰色道袍，身形消瘦，面容苍白，唯独一双眼睛布满红血丝，透着压抑的怒火与绝望——正是凌无妄的决赛对手，林浩（取自唐诗“浩气卷苍溟”，意象为浩渺天地，适配天才陨落的复杂人设）。
“凌无妄，你果然是破法者。”林浩的声音沙哑，带着咬牙切齿的恨意，“你以为你的破法能力很了不起？”
凌无妄脚步一顿，规则之眼瞬间运转，却发现林浩体内灵力异常紊乱，灵根位置空空如也，只残留着一丝微弱的特殊能量。
【检测到林浩状态灵根被人为摧毁，残留“闭源压制能量”，修为停留在炼气中期，却能短暂影响破法能力】
“我不认识你，也不知道什么破法者。”凌无妄警惕地看着他，“你拦我，有什么目的？”
“目的？”林浩突然狂笑起来，笑声凄厉，“我要让你知道，道院容不下任何清醒的人！你以为你能靠破法能力横行？迟早会和我一样，被废去灵根，沦为笑柄！”
他猛地逼近一步，眼中闪过一丝疯狂“三年前，我是道院最年轻的内门弟子，灵根纯净，修为精进神速。可就因为我发现了内门长老修炼的功法有漏洞，是篡改天道的闭源邪术，他们就废了我的灵根，把我贬为外门弟子，受尽欺凌！”
凌无妄心中一震，想起了老乞丐说的“道院是囚笼”，看来林浩也是道院黑暗的受害者。
“你想说什么？”凌无妄问道。
林浩从怀中掏出一张折叠的纸条，狠狠砸在凌无妄面前“这是我偷听到的消息，王坤和李管事在决赛的擂台下埋了‘吸灵阵’！”
他的声音压得极低，带着一丝急促“这阵法专门针对破法者，一旦启动，会抽取你的灵力，还会将你的破法能力记录下来，当成你是异端的证据！到时候，他们会当众废了你，抽取你的道果！”
凌无妄捡起纸条，展开一看，上面画着吸灵阵的简易图，标注着阵眼位置和启动方式。规则之眼扫过，确认这确实是针对破法者的高阶阵法。
“你为什么要告诉我这些？”凌无妄疑惑地看着他，“我们是决赛对手，你应该希望我输才对。”
林浩冷笑一声，眼中闪过一丝复杂的情绪“我恨道院，恨那些篡改天道的杂碎！我不想看到你这样的破法者，也落得和我一样的下场！”
他转身就要走，留下一句冰冷的话“明日决赛，我会全力以赴。你要么赢了我，揭穿他们的阴谋；要么和我一起，死在这吸灵阵中！”
看着林浩消失在竹林深处的背影，凌无妄握紧了手中的纸条。系统面板弹出提示【检测到核心线索吸灵阵由天道钱庄特制，可记录破法能力波动，配合闭源规则可判定异端身份。林浩忠诚度未知，存在利用主角复仇的可能】
第2节王坤设毒计，吸灵阵藏杀机
凌无妄回到外门居所，立刻将纸条铺在桌上，运转规则之眼仔细分析。吸灵阵的核心规则是“灵力抽取+能力记录”，阵眼由三颗下品灵石提供能量，启动方式是通过台下的灵力注入。

【解析吸灵阵规则需三名炼气后期修士同时向阵眼注入灵力，启动后形成能量漩涡，抽取擂台上目标的灵力，同时记录特殊能力波动。弱点阵眼灵石能量循环存在1秒间隙，可通过高频灵力冲击打断】
“无妄哥，怎么了？”凌小妹端来一盏油灯，看到凌无妄凝重的神色，担忧地问道，“是不是明天的决赛有危险？”
“嗯。”凌无妄点点头，将纸条递给她，“擂台下埋了吸灵阵，王坤和李管事想把我定为异端。”
凌母闻言，脸色瞬间变得苍白“那我们快跑吧，不要参加决赛了！”
“不能跑。”凌无妄摇摇头，“跑了就等于承认自己是异端，他们会派人追杀我们，而且我也进不了内门藏书阁，找不到原初灵气，激活不了玉佩，永远也揭不开墨规子的阴谋。”
就在这时，孟春突然敲门进来，神色慌张“凌兄弟，不好了！我刚才看到王坤带着三个内门弟子去了擂台，他们手里拿着灵石，应该是去布置吸灵阵了！”
“我知道了。”凌无妄站起身，眼神坚定，“孟春，麻烦你明天决赛时，带几个可靠的杂役，在擂台周围接应我。一旦看到我发出信号，就想办法干扰台下的王坤他们，阻止他们启动吸灵阵。”
“没问题！”孟春毫不犹豫地答应，“凌兄弟，你放心，我们一定帮你！”
孟春走后，凌无妄开始思考应对之策。吸灵阵的关键在于阵眼的三颗灵石，只要破坏其中一颗，阵法就会失效。但擂台被重兵把守，现在根本无法靠近。
现在根本无法靠近。
“只能在决赛时，想办法破坏阵眼了。”凌无妄喃喃自语，“林浩说他会全力以赴，他的实力虽然不如从前，但也不容小觑。而且他体内残留的特殊能量，能影响我的破法能力，这场比赛，恐怕会很艰难。”
他运转开源心法，巩固自身灵力，同时回忆苏晚晴给的手抄本，寻找破解吸灵阵的方法。手抄本中记载，原初灵力可以克制闭源阵法，或许可以用开源心法催动原初灵力，破坏吸灵阵的能量循环。
【检测到主角尝试融合开源心法与原初灵力，规则之眼进化进度60%。警告强行融合可能导致灵力紊乱，存在重伤风险】
凌无妄没有犹豫，开始尝试融合。开源心法的灵力流动与闭源功法截然不同，刚一运转，就感觉到体内灵力剧烈波动，经脉传来阵阵刺痛。但他咬牙坚持，规则之眼不断调整灵力流动轨迹，逐渐找到融合的平衡点。
就在这时，窗外传来一声轻微的响动。凌无妄立刻停止修炼，警惕地看向窗外，只见一道黑影一闪而过，正是林浩。
“他在监视我？”凌无妄心中疑惑，林浩的行为越来越奇怪，既警告他吸灵阵的危险，又在暗中监视他，到底有什么目的？
第3节同是天涯客，决赛定生死
content_en:
Chapter 1: Wasted spiritual roots cut off the path, and those who break the law meet the same path
On the eve of the finals of the outer sect competition, a black shadow suddenly jumped out of the bamboo forest in the mountain behind the sect, blocking Ling Wuwang's way.
The person who came was wearing a gray monk's robe that had been washed white, with a thin figure and a pale face. Only a pair of eyes were covered with red bloodshot eyes, revealing suppressed anger and despair - it was Ling Wuwang's opponent in the finals, Lin Hao (taken from the Tang Dynasty poem "The Great Qi Rolls into the Cangming", the image is the vast world, suitable for the complex character of the fallen genius).
"Ling Wuwang, you are indeed a magic breaker." Lin Hao's voice was hoarse, filled with gnashing hatred, "Do you think your magic breaking ability is great?"
Ling Wuwang paused, and the Eye of Rules instantly moved, only to find that the spiritual power in Lin Hao's body was abnormally disordered, and the spiritual roots were empty, with only a faint trace of special energy remaining.
[It was detected that Lin Hao’s state spiritual root was artificially destroyed, and the “closed source suppression energy” remained. His cultivation level stayed in the middle stage of Qi refining, but it could temporarily affect his ability to break spells]
"I don't know you, and I don't know what a lawbreaker is." Ling Wuwang looked at him warily, "What's the purpose of stopping me?"
"Purpose?" Lin Hao suddenly laughed wildly, his laughter was shrill, "I want you to know that the Taoist Academy cannot tolerate anyone who is sober! Do you think you can rely on your ability to break magic? Sooner or later, you will be like me, your spiritual roots will be destroyed, and you will become a laughing stock!"
He took a step closer suddenly, with a flash of madness in his eyes. "Three years ago, I was the youngest inner disciple of the Taoist Academy. I had pure spiritual roots and rapid progress in cultivation. But just because I discovered that there were loopholes in the exercises practiced by the elders of the inner sect, which were closed-source evil arts that tampered with the way of heaven. They destroyed my spiritual roots and demoted me to an outer disciple, where I suffered all kinds of bullying!"
Ling Wuwang was shocked, remembering what the old beggar said, "The Taoist temple is a prison." It seemed that Lin Hao was also a victim of the darkness in the Taoist temple.
"What do you want to say?" Ling Wuwang asked.
Lin Hao took out a folded piece of paper from his arms and smashed it in front of Ling Wuwang. "This is the news I overheard. Wang Kun and Manager Li buried the 'Spirit Absorbing Array' under the ring in the finals!"
His voice was extremely low, with a hint of urgency. "This formation is specifically targeted at spell breakers. Once activated, it will extract your spiritual power and record your spell breaking ability as evidence that you are a heretic! When the time comes, they will dethrone you in public and extract your Dao Fruit!"
Ling Wuwu picked up the note and unfolded it. On it was a simple diagram of the spirit-absorbing array, with the location of the array's eyes and how to activate it. The Eye of Rules scanned it and confirmed that this was indeed a high-level formation targeting spell breakers.
"Why are you telling me this?" Ling Wuwang looked at him doubtfully, "We are opponents in the finals, you should want me to lose."
Lin Hao sneered, with a trace of complicated emotions flashing in his eyes, "I hate the Taoist Academy and those idiots who tamper with the way of heaven! I don't want to see a lawbreaker like you end up like me!"
He turned to leave, leaving behind a cold word, "Tomorrow's final, I will go all out. You can either defeat me and expose their conspiracy; or join me and die in this soul-absorbing formation!"
Looking at Lin Hao's back disappearing into the depths of the bamboo forest, Ling Wuwang clenched the note in his hand. The system panel pops up a prompt [Core clue detected. The soul-absorbing array is specially made by Tiandao Bank. It can record fluctuations in law-breaking ability, and can determine the identity of heretics in conjunction with closed-source rules. Lin Hao’s loyalty is unknown, and there is the possibility of using the protagonist to take revenge]
Section 2 Wang Kun devises a poisonous plan, and the soul-absorbing array hides murderous intent
Ling Wuwang returned to his outer residence, immediately spread the note on the table, and analyzed it carefully using his eye of rules. The core rule of the spirit-absorbing array is "spiritual energy extraction + ability recording". The array eyes are powered by three low-grade spiritual stones, and are activated by injecting spiritual energy from the audience.
[Analysis of the rules of the spirit-absorbing array requires three late-stage Qi-refining monks to inject spiritual power into the array eyes at the same time. After activation, an energy vortex is formed, extracting the spiritual power of the target on the arena, and recording special abilities at the same time.Force fluctuations. Weakness: There is a 1-second gap in the energy cycle of the array eye spirit stone, which can be interrupted by high-frequency spiritual energy impact]
"Brother Wuwang, what's wrong?" Ling Xiaomei brought an oil lamp. Seeing Ling Wuwang's solemn expression, she asked worriedly, "Is tomorrow's finals in danger?"
"Yes." Ling Wuwang nodded and handed the note to her, "There is a soul-absorbing array buried under the arena. Wang Kun and Manager Li want to label me as a heretic."
When Ling's mother heard this, her face instantly turned pale, "Then let's run quickly and don't want to participate in the finals!"
"You can't run." Ling Wuwang shook his head. "Running away would be equivalent to admitting that you are a heretic. They will send people to hunt us down. Moreover, I can't enter the inner library, cannot find the original spiritual energy, cannot activate the jade pendant, and will never be able to uncover Mo Guizi's conspiracy."
At this moment, Meng Chun suddenly knocked on the door and came in with a panic expression, "Brother Ling, it's not good! I just saw Wang Kun taking three inner disciples to the ring. They were holding spirit stones in their hands. They should be setting up the spirit-absorbing array!"
"I understand." Ling Wuwang stood up with a firm look in his eyes, "Meng Chun, please bring a few reliable handymen to support me around the ring during the finals tomorrow. Once you see me sending a signal, you will find a way to interfere with Wang Kun and others in the audience and prevent them from activating the soul-absorbing array."
"No problem!" Meng Chun agreed without hesitation, "Brother Ling, don't worry, we will definitely help you!"
After Meng Chun left, Ling Wuwang began to think about how to deal with it. The key to the spirit-absorbing array lies in the three spirit stones in the center of the array. As long as one of them is destroyed, the array will be ineffective. But the arena is heavily guarded, and it's impossible to get close now.
It's impossible to get close now.
"We can only find a way to destroy the formation in the finals." Ling Wuwang murmured to himself, "Lin Hao said that he will go all out. Although his strength is not as good as before, it should not be underestimated. Moreover, the special energy left in his body can affect my ability to break spells. This game will probably be very difficult."
He used the Kaiyuan Mind Technique to consolidate his spiritual power. At the same time, he recalled the manuscript given by Su Wanqing to find a way to crack the spirit-absorbing array. It is recorded in the manuscript that the original spiritual power can restrain the closed-source formation. Perhaps the open-source mind method can be used to stimulate the original spiritual power and destroy the energy cycle of the spirit-absorbing formation.
[It is detected that the protagonist is trying to fuse the open source mental method and the original spiritual power, and the evolution progress of the Eye of Rules is 60%. Warning: Forced fusion may cause spiritual disorder and risk of serious injury]
Ling Wuwang did not hesitate and began to try to fuse. The flow of spiritual power in the open-source method is completely different from that of the closed-source method. As soon as it starts to operate, you will feel violent fluctuations in the spiritual power in your body, and bursts of tingling pain will come from your meridians. But he gritted his teeth and persisted. The Eye of Rules continued to adjust the flow of spiritual power and gradually found the balance point of integration.
At this moment, there was a slight noise outside the window. Ling Wuwang immediately stopped practicing and looked out the window warily, only to see a black shadow flash past, it was Lin Hao.
"He's spying on me?" Ling Wuwang was confused. Lin Hao's behavior was getting more and more strange. He not only warned him of the dangers of the spirit-absorbing array, but also secretly monitored him. What was his purpose?
In the third quarter, both are Tianya guests, and the final determines life and death.
